notes: The 13,900 EUR figure is per semester for non-EU applicants (EU/EEA/Türkiye and visa-free applicants pay 12,900 EUR). The general site page says the next application period opens in December 2026 for the September 2027 intake, but no day/ month deadline for that intake is stated; the only dated deadline (30 June 2026, on the application portal) is for the September 2026 intake and is not stated as being for international/non-EU applicants, so no intake deadline was extracted. Two documents (Declaration about recruitment, Declaration about your 2nd study programme, proof of the 100 EUR application fee) are only relevant in specific cases and were not listed as standard documents. The 15,900 EUR figure for higher-level vocational training and postgraduate courses does not apply to this BSc.
